Peer feedback for appraisals at Indian consulting firms

For firms of 40 to 400 people. Every two weeks, the people on each project give two minutes of feedback. Partners and engagement managers see it before calibration.

Start with a 12-week pilot for up to 40 people. ₹25,000 plus GST, taken off your first annual bill if you sign.

See the 2-minute walkthrough

1

What happens at calibration today

  • At calibration, the partner a consultant is staffed with now carries the most weight.
  • Recent projects count for more than the ones before them.
  • A consultant who rolled off a project months ago has nobody to present the case.
  • HR is still chasing feedback forms in the week the ratings close.

2

Two minutes every two weeks

The project team gives feedback while the work is fresh

Every two weeks, Fortnightly Feedback asks each person about the people they worked with on the project: how it went, and which of the firm's values stood out (Exhibit 1). It takes about two minutes.

Each consultant sees how their work is landing

Insights shows a consultant's score cycle by cycle and the comments colleagues wrote, without the writer's name.

Partners and engagement managers see the whole project team

Partners and engagement managers who have the Manager role see Team Insights: how the project team is rated, and the edit requests waiting for them. The ratings at calibration stay with the partners.

The head of talent sets it up

With the Admin role, the head of talent sets the firm's values and the two-week cycle, and adds people from a spreadsheet.

Our pricing

3

What you get and what stays private

Setup and training
Our team sets Sphyr up with your head of talent and trains your people, with training materials they keep. Support is part of the price.
What stays private
Ratings are grouped before anyone sees them, and the person rated sees comments without the writer's name. Managers approve requests to edit sent feedback, so they see who asked.
Your results
Results stay with your firm unless you agree to share them.
What a pilot measures
Turnout in each cycle and how many colleagues give feedback to each consultant. At the end, whether partners saw something new before calibration, and whether consultants want to keep going.
